name: IF-RewardBench
description: IF-RewardBench is a meta-evaluation benchmark for instruction-following judge models, covering diverse instruction and constraint types. It constructs preference graphs with pairwise preferences among multiple responses to enable listwise evaluation of judge models' ability to rank responses, aligning better with model optimization scenarios.
reputation: Newly proposed benchmark from a recent arXiv paper; not yet known to have broad community adoption.
notes: Enables listwise evaluation paradigm for judge models, improving over pairwise evaluation and better correlating with downstream task performance.
